name: @mandusec/conformance
description: Mandu conformance test suite. A declarative, scenario-driven harness modeled on adfi-openclaw's tests/lib/assertions.ts DSL + test/e2e YAML scenario format. Boots the REAL arbiter (Unix-socket NDJSON daemon) and the REAL Track A ingress proxy (AnthropicProxy for Claude, OpenAiProxy for Codex) against a MOCK upstream — no API key, no network — and asserts the §9 symbolization invariant + the data-trust / data-usage / exec policies through the actual components. Imports the sibling packages directly; owns no sources beyond lib/ + scenarios/.

scripts.test:integrity: export MANDU_AXES_STRICT=1 MANDU_HOME=/dev/null/mandu-test-home MANDU_POLICY_FILE=/dev/null/mandu-test-no-policy.yaml && tsx run.ts && tsx lib/unit_egress_gate.ts
scripts.conformance: tsx run.ts && tsx lib/unit_symbolization.ts && tsx lib/unit_egress_gate.ts
